executive_summary: Maven compilation failed with 26 type incompatibility errors. A custom Column class in com.myproject.models.entities conflicts with the JPA @Column annotation, causing the compiler to interpret field annotations as the wrong type. All entity classes (Column, Task, User, BoardColumn) are affected. Fix requires renaming the custom Column class or using fully qualified JPA annotation names.

errors.message: 26 errors: com.myproject.models.entities.Column cannot be converted to java.lang.annotation.Annotation across Column.java, Task.java, User.java, BoardColumn.java
errors.root_cause: A custom class named 'Column' exists in the entities package, creating a naming conflict with the JPA @Column annotation. The compiler resolves 'Column' to the custom class instead of javax.persistence.Column annotation, causing type incompatibility errors on all entity field declarations.
errors.fix_recommendation: Rename the custom Column class to a non-conflicting name (e.g., ColumnEntity, BoardColumnEntity, or TaskColumn). Alternatively, use fully qualified annotation names (@javax.persistence.Column) in all entity classes, though renaming is the cleaner solution.
